description.zh: 国际象棋、中国象棋、五子棋、围棋、斗兽棋、飞行棋六种经典棋类合为一体。大厅选棋种、就地选模式，双人对弈或三档人机随时开局；六种棋共用同一套棋谱、战绩、音效与主题，切换棋种不用回首页。
description.en: Chess, Xiangqi, Gomoku, Go, Jungle and Ludo in one app. Pick a board and a mode in the lobby, then play locally or against one of three AI levels. Shared move record, stats, sound and theming across all six.

controls.zh: 大厅选择棋种与模式，点击棋盘落子
controls.en: Choose a board and mode in the lobby, then click the board
